key_insight: TreeC learns understandable residential energy-management strategies with competitive performance against model predictive control and reinforcement learning.
engineering_relevance: Coordinating batteries, heat pumps, EV charging, and photovoltaic systems can reduce electricity costs, though implementation costs may outweigh savings.
method: Compare rule-based, optimization, and machine-learning energy management.
Develop TreeC to learn understandable control strategies.
Evaluate methods in three simulation cases and one real-world experiment.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports competitive TreeC performance across diverse problems, but both TreeC and model predictive control performed worse on real hardware than in simulations.
watch_item: Deployment requires representative training data and reliable real-time inputs; current implementation costs and effort exceed average savings in the studied Belgian dwellings.
paper_title: How to Effectively Manage the Energy in Residential Systems: Development and Comparison of Methods
